today.description: Date the run parsed for (TODAY env, else local date). The merge refuses a required source whose today differs from its own TODAY.

record_count.description: Records in latest.json; the merge checks it against the file.

complete.description: Every page fetched and parsed. Always true for written aggregator runs; official may be partial.

key.description: Source name for aggregators, sources.json key for official.

game.description: Official title of that key; null for aggregators.

unknown_labels.description: Source title labels missing from GAME (report: 未対応のタイトル名).

notes.description: Official: the 公式サイト取得ログ lines.

usage.description: Official: provider ledger (calls, tokens, cost) per provider.

games.description: Official: display titles in this run's scope (every sources.json key of the title was read; a --games run lists only its own). The merge treats a title as checked only when it is listed here and all its pages have error null. null for aggregators.
